target_description: Expected run metric over split/mask/algorithm randomisation, conditional on fixed datasets and the finite grid; metrics are averaged after evaluation, not computed from pooled predictions.
excluded_redundant_metric: TPR_gap equals EO and is not analysed twice
primary_family_definition: all estimable four reference-coded B:C DID marginal over M/A across included dataset/model and DP/EO/EOdd
multiplicity: BH within declared cross-dataset/model/metric families; BY sensitivity q_by; skipped tests remain counted in family size
intervals: pointwise t approximation and seed-block percentile bootstrap
bootstrap_joint: one common seed-index matrix across every metric and contrast
bootstrap_sign_fraction: fraction with observed estimate sign; stability, not probability of truth
descriptive_SS: orthogonal observed-run SS; eta2_total includes seed variation; eta2_design uses treatment means only; no partial omega2
secondary_omnibus: Hotelling T2 on main/two-way vectors, independent multivariate-normal blocks assumed; dimension>=n or deficient covariance causes skip
limitations: Overlapping splits create no new independent patients.
Fewer than 20 blocks are flagged as limited replication.
Previously inspected results preclude a preregistered confirmatory label.
No absence of higher-order interactions is inferred.
